definitions.explanation: Elastic material obtained from the latex of rubber trees (mainly パラゴムノキ, Hevea brasiliensis). Contrasts with synthetic rubber ({合成|ごうせい}ゴム) made from petrochemicals.

examples.japanese: {天然|てんねん}ゴム⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手袋|てぶくろ}→手袋：01063_tebukuro⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦タイヤ→タイヤ：06330_taiya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{天然|てんねん}ゴム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This tire is made of natural rubber.

examples.japanese: {天然|てんねん}ゴム⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{弾力性|だんりょくせい}→弾力性：25758_danryokusei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れている→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧。

{天然|てんねん}ゴム⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{東南|とうなん}アジア→東南アジア：16277_tounanajia⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{熱帯|ねったい}{雨林|うりん}→熱帯雨林：19014_nettaiurin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}つ→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧⟦ゴム→ゴム：00073_gomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{採|と}れる→採る：20862_toru⟧。
examples.english: Natural rubber is harvested from rubber trees that grow in the tropical rainforests of Southeast Asia.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧ (natural) and ⟦ゴム→ゴム：00073_gomu⟧ (rubber, from Dutch {gom}). Written with the second element in katakana because ⟦ゴム→ゴム：00073_gomu⟧ is a loanword.

USAGE:
- Used as a material noun, typically in attributive form with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {天然|てんねん}ゴム⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手袋|てぶくろ}→手袋：01063_tebukuro⟧ (natural rubber gloves).
- Contrasted almost automatically with ⟦{合成|ごうせい}ゴム→合成ゴム：23701_gouseigomu⟧ (synthetic rubber) in technical and commercial contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天然|てんねん}ゴム⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦タイヤ→タイヤ：06330_taiya⟧: natural rubber tire
- {天然|てんねん}ゴム⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧: made of natural rubber
- {天然|てんねん}ゴムアレルギー: natural rubber latex allergy
- {天然|てんねん}ゴム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{採取|さいしゅ}→採取：12901_saishu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to harvest natural rubber

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{合成|ごうせい}ゴム→合成ゴム：23701_gouseigomu⟧: synthetic rubber — made from petrochemicals
- ラテックス: latex — the milky sap from which natural rubber is made, or thin rubber film products
- ⟦ゴム→ゴム：00073_gomu⟧: rubber — the general term; may refer to either natural or synthetic
